about.title: about
about.whatIsThis: this is a fan-made archive of translated posts and clips, kept so they don't disappear when the originals do.
about.credits: every entry credits the translator who made it, linked to their own page here. nothing here is claimed as this site's own work.
about.logoCredit: the logo was made for this site and isn't an official mark.
privacy.title: privacy
privacy.whoRuns: who runs this: a fan, reachable at the contact link below. this isn't run by, or on behalf of, any artist, agency, or platform.
privacy.whatCollected: what's collected, and why: the translations, clips and images themselves, the translator handle credited on each one, and, for anyone signed in, the minimum needed to let them manage their own entries. no email address or profile picture is stored for an X sign-in.
privacy.thirdParties: third parties: this site runs on Vercel for hosting and Neon for its database, is built on GitHub, and media may be served from X's own video hosting. each only sees what it needs to do its job.
privacy.embedNotice: posts from X: each translation page shows its original post using X's own embed, loaded from X's servers. X may set cookies and collect data about you when it loads, under its own privacy policy. the embed asks X not to use it for personalised suggestions or ads.
privacy.retention: retention: a removed entry is hidden right away and kept privately, not deleted outright. backups expire after 35 days, so it's gone from every backup within that time too. sign-in sessions last 7 days. the audit log and incident reports are pruned after 12 to 24 months.
privacy.publicPrivate: public vs private: entries, translator handles, and "added by" names are public. anything else about a signed-in person stays private.
privacy.translatorOptOut: opting out: a translator can sign in with X and opt out at any time, themselves, from their own account. that removes every entry of theirs already archived here and stops any more of their posts being added. you can also ask through the contact link below, or see the takedown page.
privacy.accountDeletion: account deletion: deleting your account is self-serve, from the "me" page. it removes your sign-in records; any "added by" credit you left on an entry still shows, now as "a fan". to erase that too, contact the owner through the link below.
privacy.noSaleNoAds: no sale, no ads: nothing here is sold, and this site carries no advertising or trackers.
privacy.noSaleNoAdsEmbed: no sale, no ads: nothing here is sold, and this site carries no advertising. apart from X's embed (see "posts from X" above), it loads no third-party scripts or trackers.
takedown.title: takedown
takedown.whoCanAsk: who can ask: the translator credited on an entry, or anyone with a post, image or clip of their own archived here.
takedown.whatToSend: what to send: a link to the entry (or the handle it's credited to) and what you'd like done — removed, or opted out entirely.
takedown.response: what happens next: the entry is hidden first, and reviewed second. you don't need to wait for a reply before it comes down.
report.title: report this
report.done: thanks — the owner will look at it
